approval: On October 9, 2026 the user requested implementation and live testing of Recommendation Agent v3. This replacement local-development grant preserves the previously approved ten-run, one-profile measurement limits, adds no extra retries or publishing permission, keeps technical Browse disabled, authorizes one recommendation-model call per run, and uses the specified 8,000-token maximum for the Recommendation Planner after the 4,000-token canary reached its output limit.
